title: Mango Chili Lime Paletas
hook: Four days of pie is enough. Mango chili lime pops: 5 ingredients, almost all fruit
benefit: Almost all fruit, so every pop is full of vitamin C and fiber with no refined sugar
ingredients: 4 cups mango chunks, fresh or frozen (about 2 large ripe mangoes), divided
1 to 2 tbsp honey (skip it if your mangoes are very sweet)
1 1/2 tsp chili lime seasoning such as Tajin, divided, plus more for serving
8 popsicle molds (3 oz each) or small paper cups with wooden sticks
steps: Set aside 1/2 cup of the mango and dice it small. Put the other 3 1/2 cups in a blender with the water, lime juice and 1 tablespoon of honey. Blend on high for about 1 minute until completely smooth. Taste and add the second tablespoon of honey only if it needs it.
Stir in the diced mango and 1 teaspoon of the chili lime seasoning by hand so the little pieces stay whole.

Pour the mix into 8 popsicle molds or 3-ounce paper cups, leaving 1/4 inch of space at the top for the pops to expand. Freeze for 1 hour, push a stick into the center of each, then freeze for at least 4 more hours or overnight.

To unmold, run the outside of the molds under warm water for 10 to 20 seconds and pull gently. Sprinkle the remaining 1/2 teaspoon of chili lime seasoning over the pops and add a squeeze of lime. Keep them in the freezer in a zip bag for up to 2 weeks.
vo_steps: Dice half a cup of mango and set it aside. Blend the rest with the water, lime juice and honey for one minute until smooth.
Stir in the diced mango and a teaspoon of chili lime seasoning.
Pour into eight molds or paper cups, freeze one hour, add the sticks, then freeze four more hours.
Run the molds under warm water to unmold, then finish with more chili lime seasoning and a squeeze of lime.
